sourceTitle: The violin and the art of its construction: a treatise on the Stradivarius violin
description: "The Violin and the Art of Its Construction: A Treatise on the Stradivarius" by August Riechers is a scientific publication written in the late 19th century. This treatise provides an in-depth exploration of the craftsmanship involved in building violins, specifically focusing on the techniques and principles attributed to the legendary luthier Antonio Stradivarius.
